verdict.rationale: The firm's own private equity page documents support through to "exits" and "going-private transactions". It also cites a stand-out M&A deal, the Rajasthan Royals acquisition, and the homepage names venture capital funds and start-ups as clients. However, no public-offering or IPO page appears in the evidence, and the M&A deal shown is not for a venture-backed company. Missing for 10: documented IPO/capital-markets practice pages, M&A exits specifically for venture-backed startups, a dedicated M&A practice page, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm can carry the company through to exit — M&A and public-offering experience for venture-backed companies is documented on its own pages

citations.quote: from fund formation to growth transactions, PIPE deals, buyouts, going-private transactions, and exits
Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised the Buyer Consortium on the acquisition of the IPL franchise Rajasthan Royals, for USD 1.6 Billion
